author: GH-Jaider

brief.en: Four steps rise between Karel and the beeper. Climb one riser at a time and never come back down.
brief.es: Cuatro escalones separan a Karel del zumbador. Sube de uno en uno y no vuelvas a bajar.

solution:
BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM
    DEFINE-NEW-INSTRUCTION turnright AS
    BEGIN
        turnleft;
        turnleft;
        turnleft
    END
    BEGINNING-OF-EXECUTION
        WHILE not-next-to-a-beeper DO
        BEGIN
            IF front-is-clear THEN
                move
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                turnleft;
                move;
                turnright
            END
        END
        pickbeeper;
        turnoff
    END-OF-EXECUTION
END-OF-PROGRAM
